name: Whole Building Electrification
description: $4,250 for single-family homes ($2,200 per multifamily/ADU unit) for removing ALL gas appliances and installing electric alternatives (heat pump heating, heat pump water heating, induction cooking, electric dryer); bonuses for heat pump dryers and electrical upgrades
fullDescription: The California Energy-Smart Homes program provides incentives for fully electrifying existing homes by removing all gas appliances and switching to efficient electric alternatives. 2026 funding is fully subscribed; a waitlist is open.
whatTheyOffer:
- $4,250 for single-family whole-home electrification
- $2,200 per unit for multifamily low-rise buildings and ADUs
- $250 bonus for a heat pump clothes dryer
- Electrical infrastructure upgrade bonus (up to $1,000 single-family, $600 per multifamily unit)
- Must include heat pump heating, heat pump water heating, induction cooking, and an electric dryer
- Homes with existing electric cooking do not need to add induction
howToGetIt:
1. Must be in PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E electric territory
2. Plan to replace ALL gas appliances with electric and cap gas lines
3. Apply to the waitlist on the Energy-Smart Homes website
4. Use a licensed contractor to complete the work
5. Submit documentation for the incentive
6. Propane-to-electric conversions do not qualify
keywords: Energy Smart Homes, electrification, $4250, remove gas, heat pump, induction, electric dryer, all-electric home, ADU, multi-family, waitlist
